speech_en: Fold it right, then off to the lab!
speech_de: Richtig falten, dann ab ins Labor!
scenario: One single big, cheerful, blobby sausage-shaped ER character lying diagonally across the frame with a big happy face. Its near half is ribbed (rough ER) with small round workbench-robot friends (ribosomes) perched along the ribs, each hugging a folded parcel. Its far half is smooth (smooth ER) with two round bubbling-flask friends nestled against soft side-bumps. A small wheeled cargo-cart character (a transport vesicle) hops off where ribbed meets smooth, and a tiny stack of pancake shapes (a distant Golgi friend) sits small in a corner. Background: a scatter of small round friend-circles and bubbles filling the gaps, several sliced by the picture's edges.
status: RENDERED after 7 AI attempts plus one deterministic crop fix — the two hard failure modes fought each other on this subject and it took real iteration to land both. Attempt 1 (spiral/racetrack corridor) produced a continuous rectangular border line running parallel to all four edges. Attempt 2 (diagonal corridor entering/exiting through named corners) made the border WORSE (a full black rectangle) and additionally baked in text ('WORKSHOP FLOOR', 'SMOOTH-TUBE') because the scene description used those as section names — a lesson to avoid any capitalised label-like phrase in the scenario text, even when only meant as internal vocabulary. Attempt 3 (single coiled spiral tube) still produced a border. Attempt 4 (spiral again, more explicit anti-border language) also kept the border AND introduced thin radiating spoke-lines connecting the ribosome ring to the centre, close to a forbidden starburst pattern. Attempt 5 changed the whole concept to a single diagonal 'sausage' character (mirroring the mitochondrion set's successful jellybean-character recipe instead of a corridor/spiral, since curved racetrack-like compositions seem to be what was triggering the model's border reflex) — this FINALLY produced NO border and no true starburst, but left two corners (bottom-left, top-right) and the whole top edge with plain white margin, and a few small comic-style 'shine' highlight curves on the character's rounded ends. Attempt 6 (same concept, explicit instructions to push large shapes into the two empty corners) fixed the bleed and removed the shine marks, but the explicit 'push shapes to physically cross the edges' phrasing brought the border straight back (confirmed by pixel inspection: a clean ~7px dark rule inset at rows/cols 0-6 on all four sides, and a matching band near the far edge — a true full rectangle, not just a corner artifact). Attempt 7 (same concept, softer 'let it scatter naturally near the edges' phrasing, no corner-forcing language) again avoided the border but reverted to incomplete bleed with large white margins on most sides. Given the pattern — corner/edge-forcing language reliably re-triggers this model's border reflex, while removing that language reliably loses full bleed — attempt 6 (the best composition and bleed of all seven, its only flaw being the border) was kept, and the border was removed with a plain DETERMINISTIC PIXEL CROP rather than a further AI attempt or edit_image.py: pixel inspection confirmed the dark rule sits at rows/cols 0-6 and mirrors it at the far edges of the 1024x1024 raw PNG, so the image was cropped to (8,8,1016,1016) — an 8px trim off all four sides, well clear of the border but not touching any character — before being re-traced through the project's own to_bitmap/trace_paths pipeline (same threshold=145, same potrace call) to produce the final SVG. No pixels were generated, re-illustrated or altered beyond this crop; the artwork itself is 100% the attempt-6 AI generation. Viewed after tracing: clean full bleed on all four edges (top-left ribosome cluster, top-right circle, bottom-left pancake stack and bottom-right circle all sliced by their corners), no border, no starburst/radiating lines, no baked-in text, bilingual speech bubble renders correctly.
command: uv run --script .claude/skills/microbe-render/scripts/coloring.py --microbe endoplasmic-reticulum --set organelles --prompt-file <attempt-6 prompt> --speech-en "Fold it right, then off to the lab!" --speech-de "Richtig falten, dann ab ins Labor!" --attempt 6   (then a deterministic 8px crop of the attempt-6 raw PNG, re-traced with coloring.py's own to_bitmap/trace_paths/build_svg at threshold=145 — no further paid render)
